name: Ronald Araujo

career_stints.note: Recorded as CB because no reliable minute-by-minute CB/RB split was available. Official Liverpool reporting separately confirms his right-back capability.
Competitive debut as a centre-back substitute at Newcastle on 23 August 2026; 20 minutes recorded by FotMob.

notes: Liverpool confirmed a season-long loan from Barcelona on 10 August 2026 and shirt number 33. He made his competitive debut from the bench at Newcastle on 23 August.

The official club factfile reports 71 open-play passes per 90 with 92% completion, 4.92 aerial duels contested per 90 and 3.31 won per 90 in La Liga 2025/26. These scopes do not map exactly to the current general pass-accuracy or total-duel fields, so they remain in notes rather than being forced into incompatible fields.
FotMob reports 1,061 La Liga minutes in 2025/26 and 20 Liverpool minutes in the opening 2026/27 league match.

Sources: liverpoolfc.com (loan confirmation, role, shirt number, Opta-derived 2025/26 factfile and Newcastle debut), fotmob.com (career totals, season minutes and Liverpool appearance) -- accessed 2026-08-24.
